timing_note: Head/base both include ID/objective and rescore capture; head additionally records actual capacities, d-only potential and combined kept counts. No overhead subtraction.

baseline.reuse: PR #143 squash merge has identical production source and benchmark; fixed environment/wheel exactly equal.

workspace: Uniform int32 original-pair indices when count<=int32 max; retained prefix slots=count+ceil(count/2), otherwise 2count. Preserve base table-selection choice for the d-only path. Rule-e reserves block_size*(16q+64) additional slots, with block_size=min(outgoing_count,max(1,available_base//(2*(16q+64)))), only if a rho>=1e-6 outgoing pair has a nonempty d prefix and the workspace fits. One batched sort/searchsorted per block; e theta fixed per block and d theta refreshed per tile. n<=p+1 cannot have SPD two-row removal and keeps d-only capacities. Base capacities are calculated from the exact state-independent #141 formula; head capacities are observed at tile-generator entry.
